action_items: The Resend account is on the free/testing tier, which — even with the onboarding@resend.dev sender — only permits sending to the account owner's email (aakashv2304@gmail.com). To actually deliver to CGO/Finance/creator recipients, you MUST verify a custom domain (e.g., botree.co.in) at https://resend.com/domains and set SENDER_EMAIL to an address on that verified domain (e.g., no-reply@botree.co.in). OR upgrade the Resend account plan.

For an immediate smoke-test of delivery, temporarily change the recipient in send_workflow_notification to aakashv2304@gmail.com — Resend will accept and deliver, confirming the code path end-to-end. This is only for validation, not production.
After domain verification + SENDER_EMAIL update, re-run create -> approve -> reject -> return and confirm 'Email sent to ... - Email ID: ...' INFO log lines appear.
notes: Code implementation is correct and robust. Blocker is purely Resend account configuration (sandbox mode). The switch to onboarding@resend.dev resolved the domain-verification error but did not enable free sending to arbitrary recipients — this is a documented Resend policy.
